summary.text: Nathan Burnett is the Democratic candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary.
A high school math teacher, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he wants to be a voice for workers.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Burnett graduated from Presque Isle High School and earned bachelor's degrees from the University of Maine in 2007 and the University of Southern Maine in 2024.
In his survey response, he said he was born in Australia, moved to Maine at 14, and taught math at Sacopee Valley High School for 13 years.
He said he is not currently teaching because his school district's population declined and a math position was cut.
Burnett's survey response says he has spoken with people at more than 5,000 doors this year and that property taxes and healthcare costs were the top concerns he heard.

He named rural internet connectivity, including finishing the state's broadband investment, as a state-level priority, and listed education, technology and infrastructure as his areas of policy interest.
